blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Jia De Guzman savored Creamline’s 10th straight PVL All-Filipino Conference finals despite the tough road to get there in the Siklab Series. De Guzman orchestrated Creamline’s balanced offense with 19 excellent sets as six players scored at least eight points to eliminate sister team Choco Mucho, 21-25, 25-17, 25-17, 25-23, in the semifinals on Tuesday at the Philsports Arena. “There’s never a finals appearance that isn’t earned. Throughout all the years of Creamline, in every finals we’ve reached and even those we didn’t, there has never been a smooth journey,” said De Guzman in Filipino. “I guess the […]...
